Q: curl: (35) error:0A000152:SSL routines::unsafe legacy renegotiation disabled A:

If this is occuring while you trying to push to your git

I used this fix... you will have to run the command as Admin

git config --system http.sslbackend schannel

Q: Add breakpoint in Visual Studio Code A:

If you are using different extensions for debugging, e.g. DeZog (https://github.com/maziac/dezog) to debug Z80 assembly and NASM Code Lens (https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=maziac.asm-code-lens) for intellisense you might have this problem as well.

To fix this go to the settings and look for asm-code-lens. Set the assembler to sjasmplus (in the user settings). This is a Z80 assembler.

asm-code-lens checks your *.asm files and by default associates them with the nasm assembler (which is an x86 assembler).

Q: pkg-config: PKG_PROG_PKG_CONFIG: command not found A:

Had the same issue with linux Alpine for an DockerImage.

Solved it by installing autoconf, automake and pkgconf:

apk --update add autoconf automake build-base libtool nasm pkgconf

Q: crbug/1173575, non-JS module files deprecated on Chrome Extension A:

to get rid of this error (crbug/1173575, non-JS module files deprecated.) I have to change the Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy in .htaccess file , found in Apache server's web folder, from "require-corp" to "cross-origin":


- Header set Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy "require-corp"
+ Header set Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy "cross-origin"
